summary: This is a slow-paced, aesthetic study-vlog built from long static b-roll and talking-head segments stitched together with a persistent on-screen caption style, rather than fast cutting or dense narration. Pacing is front-loaded: the opening montage and early talking-head sections carry more motion and speech than the back half, which settles into long quiet stretches of flashcards, cooking and reading with sparse voiceover.

recommendations.title: Second-half pacing drops sharply versus the first half
recommendations.observation: pacing_trend is 0.53, far below the vlog category's typical range, meaning cut rate in the second half of the runtime is much lower than the first half; several 10s bins between 117s and 300s show zero cuts and zero wpm.
recommendations.recommendation: If the goal is to sustain viewer engagement through the middle section, consider testing a few extra cutaways or ambient b-roll inserts during the longest static/silent stretches (e.g. 150-190s, 270-300s) to vary the visual rhythm.

recommendations.title: Overall loudness sits well below category norm
recommendations.observation: Mean loudness is -30.8dB, well under the vlog category median of roughly -20.75dB, and several individual bins dip to -34/-35dB.
recommendations.recommendation: Consider testing a loudness normalization pass so quieter narration segments sit closer to the rest of the category's typical level, which may make the voiceover easier to hear on average playback volumes.
